Name: Dragon Tooth Blacklist
Author: PassionFruit0001
Description:
Dragon Tooth Blacklist 1.1.0

A per-weapon blacklist for unwanted complete Dragon Tooth innate enchantment type combinations. Levels are ignored; exact whole combinations are matched.

HOW TO USE
At the Volcano Forge or vanilla Mini-Forge, place the weapon on the left and the material on the right.
1 coal removes the current innate Dragon Tooth enchantments and blacklists their complete type combination for that weapon.
1 normal quartz clears that weapon's blacklist while keeping current enchantments. These two actions cost no Cinder Shards; normal Dragon Tooth reforging keeps vanilla costs.

EXACT COMBINATIONS
Banning Attack +3 bans Attack alone at all levels, but still permits Attack + Defense. Banning Speed alone still permits Speed + Lightweight. Banning Speed + Lightweight only rejects that exact pair at all levels. This applies to all vanilla innate enchantment types.
Blacklists are stored separately per weapon. The remaining vanilla numerical outcomes retain their relative probabilities; no new enchantment combinations are invented. If all legal complete combinations have been banned, that weapon's blacklist resets automatically.
Prismatic Shard enchantments, gem upgrades, Galaxy Soul progress and weapon appearance are unaffected.

INSTALLATION
Requires SMAPI 4.5.2 or later. Built against Stardew Valley 1.6.15; the released mod was confirmed working on Steam Deck by the requesting player. No extra mod dependency.
Exit the game, extract DragonToothBlacklist into Mods, then launch through SMAPI. No Generic Mod Config Menu page is needed.

DIAGNOSTICS
Select a weapon and run dtb_check in the SMAPI console. Attach your full SMAPI-latest.txt to a GitHub issue if an operation fails. Other forge/enchantment-generator mods are not exhaustively tested.
